messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jamie Porter <jamie.porter@acme.solutions>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ARR accuracy and churn triage - account-level reconciliation & next steps

All —

Following up on the finance request: we ran a cross-check between ledger ARR and seat-level consumption and found mismatches for three high-ARR accounts (BrightByte, Clearline, Acme Solutions). Finance is asking for an account-level reconciliation to validate our renewal numbers for the upcoming forecast close.

I attached a working sheet (ARR_reconciliations_v2.xlsx) with the rows I pulled. Can each of you take ownership of the account(s) below and reply with the following by EOD Friday PDT:
- Confirm committed ARR used in forecast (and source of truth: SF/Contract/PO)
- Recent 60-day consumption trend (notes if model/instance changes impacted usage)
- Any open disputes, credits, or finance escalations
- Churn-risk flag (low/medium/high) and a one-line mitigation plan

Assignments:
- Naomi: BrightByte (they showed a 28% drop in token consumption month-over-month)
- Marissa: Clearline (renewal in 45 days, finance flagged a billing dispute)
- Ben: Acme Solutions (legal is reviewing a SOW addendum)

If anyone needs me to loop in CS or Legal immediately, call it out in your reply. I want a consolidated note Wednesday afternoon so Finance can lock the forecast.

Thanks —
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Attachment: ARR_reconciliations_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ARR accuracy and churn triage - account-level reconciliation & next steps

Rafael — thanks, taking BrightByte. Quick notes from my side (initial):

- Committed ARR per SF: $1,250,000 (latest contract signed 2027-09-30) — I attached a short summary.
- Consumption: dropped ~28% last 30 days after BrightByte switched to our smaller LlamaX-7B quantized variant on the dev cluster (they said performance was "good enough" and moved several non-prod workloads off the main prod instance).
- Open finance items: they logged a billing inquiry on 2028-05-18 about an unexpected overage; Finance ticket #FIN-1187 is open.
- Churn-risk: medium (they are price-sensitive and testing internal alternatives). Mitigation: ask CS to deliver a usage optimization review and offer a limited, time-boxed credits package contingent on an expanded renewal.

I attached brightbyte_account_notes.md with the raw convo pointers and the finance ticket. I'll reach out to contracts@brightbyte.com to confirm whether the shift to LlamaX-7B was permanent or just an experiment.

-Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Manager, Customer Finance Operations
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Attachment: brightbyte_account_notes.md (notes stub)

Team — adding Clearline detail and a quick risk calc.

Clearline (my notes):
- Committed ARR per contract: $640,000 (renewal due 2028-07-29)
- Finance dispute: invoice 2028-04-01 disputed for alleged double-billing on burst capacity; Finance case FIN-1142 shows engineering confirmed an extra burst but CS logged the usage under approved burst policy.
- Consumption trend: steady but with two burst events in Q1 2028 tied to data migration.
- Churn-risk: high (they've already initiated procurement review and requested multiple competitive quotes).

Suggested actions:
1) Escalate to CS for an executive outreach this week (I can own the customer call if Rafael wants).
2) Loop Legal and Finance to prepare a narrow credit offer if they can confirm a 12-month renewal.
3) Score: 0.78 churn probability (internal model) — treat as near-term risk; mark as forecast at 60% until we close actions.

Related: I uploaded churn_risk_scores.csv to the Drive and linked the HubSpot deal (HS-54321) for reference.

Marissa
Marissa Cole

Thanks everyone — excellent context. Consolidating next steps / mutual action plan so Finance can finalize the forecast: 

1) BrightByte (Naomi): follow up with contracts@brightbyte.com and finance to confirm whether the LlamaX-7B move is intentional; request a February-to-June consumption export and confirm any open credit request by Tue 6/19 EOD. If BrightByte requests credits, Legal + Finance to draft limited credit package tied to a 12-month renewal.

2) Clearline (Marissa): schedule executive outreach this week (Marissa to lead) and prepare a narrowly scoped credit/forgiveness offer conditioned on renewal confirmation; Finance to prepare a provisional impact note for forecast.

3) Acme (Ben): confirm SOW addendum status with Jamie and legal; confirm committed ARR used in forecast.

I created a 30-min sync for Monday 2028-06-18 10:00-10:30 PDT to finalize entries in the ARR_reconciliations_v2.xlsx and lock forecast inputs. Please upload updated numbers to the Drive link and flag any blockers ahead of the call.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cARRsheet

If anyone needs me to pull in CRO or Finance SVP before Monday, say so now. Otherwise let's treat this as the operational action list to baseline the forecast.
